material.description: Needed to gate upgrades.lua on_tick item scan, panels.lua emit_all refresh, and targeting.lua on_tick.
material.subject: Does any host native or hook tell Lua that item or unit state changed?
material.witness_evidence: Absent. The only inventory native is unit_items (rust/crates/mod-host/src/piccolo_host.rs:2484; codesearch 1792849190608-2182-4f1964c1f0046bd). No generation or dirty native (codesearch 1792849207018-2208-fb7e0e43a73a0166, 1792849211362-2210-d648543c3ba94a14). The item hook on_request (piccolo_host.rs:199, 3714, 3733; codesearch 1792849271168-2281-c8c65cc0c8d34895) is a request gate, not a change event.
